Hugely grateful to her for keeping it to a low dose psychiatric stabilization regimen rather than something that keeps him fast asleep through the day. His withdrawal from all his usual activities has come to an end and he's back to being an involved, active and mentally stable, even happy and composed person again. When it comes to sensitive matters such as Psychiatry, Mumbai needs more clear-headed, professional and yet warm and approachable doctors like this!

Anger management is a therapeutic approach designed to help individuals control and express their anger in healthy, constructive ways. This process involves identifying the triggers and underlying issues that lead to anger, as well as developing skills to manage these emotions effectively. Techniques often include relaxation methods, cognitive restructuring, and problem-solving strategies, which can help individuals pause, assess the situation, and respond calmly instead of reacting impulsively. By learning to recognize and manage anger before it escalates, individuals can maintain better relationships and reduce stress in their personal and professional lives.

Practicing anger management can significantly improve one’s emotional well-being and overall quality of life. It encourages self-awareness and promotes communication skills that are essential in navigating conflicts with empathy and understanding. Over time, individuals can replace unhealthy expressions of anger with positive outlets, such as exercise or creative activities. With consistent effort, anger management empowers individuals to maintain control, make thoughtful decisions, and cultivate a more balanced, peaceful approach to life’s challenges.
